name: tyl_investment
description: Investment OS 主系统，内置 Feishu/Codex 网关子系统

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:console
scripts.investment:agent:run: npm run build:server && node dist/investment/index.js agent:run
scripts.investment:validate: npm run build && node dist/investment/index.js validate-md
scripts.investment:rebuild-state: npm run build && node dist/investment/index.js rebuild-state
scripts.investment:test:init: INVESTMENT_ENV=test npm run build && INVESTMENT_ENV=test node dist/investment/index.js init-test-runtime
scripts.investment:test:validate: INVESTMENT_ENV=test npm run build && INVESTMENT_ENV=test node dist/investment/index.js validate-md
scripts.investment:test:rebuild-state: INVESTMENT_ENV=test npm run build && INVESTMENT_ENV=test node dist/investment/index.js rebuild-state
scripts.investment:test:cleanup: INVESTMENT_ENV=test npm run build && INVESTMENT_ENV=test node dist/investment/index.js cleanup-test-runtime
